[[Cave crawler]]s can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] at level 10 [[Slayer]] and level 10 [[Combat level|combat]] by various [[Slayer master]]s. A form of [[Poison#Curing poison|poison protection]] is recommended when killing them, as they inflict a strong poison.

Players with very low [[Defence]] should use [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] to attack these monsters in order to avoid being damaged and possibly poisoned, utilising the rocks around the room's walls in [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]] as safespots. You can use the [[fairy ring]] just outside, {{Fairycode|AJR}}, as a fast means of banking.

When fighting cave crawlers in the [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]], be aware that any exposed [[light sources]] (i.e [[candle]]s) may explode, and can cause a considerable amount of damage. As such, a [[bullseye lantern]] or an [[oil lantern]] is recommended as it is not an exposed light source. You can use the [[Lumbridge Swamp#Entrance to Zanaris shed|Zanaris Shed]] to be teleported to [[Zanaris]] as a fast method for banking (either within Zanaris or to teleport elsewhere using the fairy ring itself).

Lower level players should be aware that they have a rapid natural health regenerate rate, regenerating 1 hitpoint every 5 ticks.
